title: Rewrite accessibility matrix and VPAT evidence for compact components
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: produce a consolidated accessibility matrix and VPAT evidence package for the compact density components (compact tokens, condensed buttons, dense tables, and small charts). This ticket scopes the audit, remediation guidance, and final artifact handoff to Engineering and Compliance. Deliverables: 1) canonical accessibility matrix that maps component states to ARIA roles, keyboard patterns, and contrast targets; 2) VPAT evidence folder with annotated screenshots, test transcripts, and accepted remediation notes; 3) concise engineering tickets for implementation; 4) updated design tokens doc outlining contrast-preserving token swaps and focus ring rules.
acceptance_criteria: Accessibility matrix completed and peer-reviewed by design + accessibility SME
VPAT evidence folder contains annotated screenshots and screen reader transcripts for all components and states
Implementation tickets created (ENG keys) and dependencies identified
Design tokens proposal merged into design-system docs
Two design sign-offs (Lead Designer + Accessibility Lead) recorded
comments: 2026-03-10 Maya Chen: Kickoff — scoped compact density subset after reviewing current backlog; prioritized tokens, buttons, tables, charts. Agreed to focus on keyboard nav, ARIA semantics, and color contrast first.

2026-03-11 Lina Morales: Preliminary audit complete for tokens and buttons — found inconsistent focus ring usage across button variants (primary/secondary/ghost) and three tokens with contrast delta < 3:1 at 12px label sizes.

2026-03-11 Arjun Patel (ENG): Noted runtime constraints for tiny-button variant on mobile; suggested engineering implementation via existing focus token (focus-ring-compact) with a parameterized thickness to avoid layout shifts.
2026-03-12 Accessibility SME (Samir Kapoor): Reviewed draft matrix; recommended using role="button" plus aria-pressed for toggle chips and adding aria-describedby for charts when captions are hidden.

2026-03-12 Maya Chen: Trade-off decision — increase contrast of token-bg-02 and token-text-04 to meet minimum 4.5:1 for small labels, accepting slight visual weight change; recorded visual examples in drive.

2026-03-13 Lina Morales: Assembling VPAT evidence pack; captured VoiceOver + NVDA transcripts for table sorting and chart legend keyboard interactions. Filed GH PR with annotated screenshots: github.com/redwood/design-system/pull/3812.
2026-03-13 PM feedback (Evelyn Ross): Please include estimated eng effort per remediation and mark any changes that require product approval. Added to ticket dependencies.
2026-03-13 Design lead sign-off (Maya Chen): Matrix approved pending ENG-5019 (table row focus aggregation) and ENG-5023 (chart legend keyboard focus).
next_steps: Finalize matrix visuals and export VPAT PDF (owner: Lina) by 2026-03-18
Break remediation into ENG tickets with estimates (owner: Maya + Eng leads) by 2026-03-16
Design token PR with contrast swaps and focus token proposal (owner: Maya) — target review 2026-03-17
